options.label: Automatic (by the frame and the device)

colorCycling.name: Color cycling
colorCycling.description: Cozy pixel-art scenes animated the 8-bit way: drawn once, a byte a cell, and from then on only the palette moves. Water falls, waves roll in, rain and snow come down, smoke rises, flames lick and stars twinkle.

fields.name: pixelSize
fields.label: Pixel size
fields.hint: Each cell is a square this many pixels wide. 0 picks for the frame: about 240 cells across its short side, 160 on an ESP32.

fields.name: msPerRender
fields.label: Time per render
fields.hint: 0 moves the colors with the clock. Any other number moves them this many milliseconds each render, the same way every time.

fields.name: seed
fields.label: Seed
fields.hint: 0 draws the scene a little differently every time it starts; any other number draws the same one.

sources.config.json:
{
  "name": "Color cycling",
  "category": "data",
  "description": "Cozy pixel-art scenes animated the 8-bit way: drawn once, a byte a cell, and from then on only the palette moves. Water falls, waves roll in, rain and snow come down, smoke rises, flames lick and stars twinkle.",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "fields": [
    { "name": "scene", "type": "select", "options": ["falls", "harbor", "rain", "snow", "aurora", "campfire"], "value": "falls", "required": true, "label": "Scene" },
    { "name": "pixelSize", "type": "integer", "value": "0", "required": true, "label": "Pixel size", "hint": "Each cell is a square this many pixels wide. 0 picks for the frame: about 240 cells across its short side, 160 on an ESP32." },
    { "name": "msPerRender", "type": "integer", "value": "0", "label": "Time per render", "hint": "0 moves the colors with the clock. Any other number moves them this many milliseconds each render, the same way every time." },
    { "name": "seed", "type": "integer", "value": "0", "label": "Seed", "hint": "0 draws the scene a little differently every time it starts; any other number draws the same one." }
  ],
  "events": ["swipe"],
  "output": [{ "name": "image", "type": "image" }]
}
